checks.text: Entering the text `|A|B|C|` newline `|---|---|---|` newline `|1|2|3|` shows exactly two rows: "A, B, C" and "1, 2, 3" (the separator row is skipped).
Entering `|X|Y|` / `|---|---|` / `|a|b|` (three lines) shows exactly two rows: "X, Y" and "a, b".
Entering the single line `|1|2|3|` shows exactly one row: "1, 2, 3".
With empty input, no rows are shown (zero rows).
Entering `|A|B|` / `|---|---|` / `|C|D|` shows exactly two rows: "A, B" and "C, D".
Entering `|X|Y|Z|` / `|---|---|---|` / `|1|2|3|` shows exactly two rows: "X, Y, Z" and "1, 2, 3".
Entering `|A|B|` / `|---|---|` / `|C|D|` followed by a trailing newline shows exactly two rows: "A, B" and "C, D".
Entering `| A | B |` / `|---|---|` / `| C | D |` (extra spaces inside cells) shows exactly two rows: "A, B" and "C, D".
After entering `|A|B|` / `|---|---|` / `|C|D|` and reloading the page, the input still contains that text and the two rows "A, B" and "C, D" are still shown.
